name: Three colour stripes
what: Three tilted stripes slide in one after another, the left and right ones from the top and the middle one from below, each carrying a short word. The group then straightens into three side-by-side columns with a smooth turn, and the outer stripes flash another colour for a moment on the way.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f1-f8 the left stripe slides down; f9-f17 the middle one slides up, dark to white by f32; f21-f26 the right one slides down; each word glides in after its stripe (f5, f13, f25); f4-f114 the whole group untilts from 15 degrees to straight with one S-curve (slightly zoomed out as it straightens); f44-f55 the outer stripes shift half-way to another colour and snap back at f56; the last frames hold

tracks.name: left stripe
tracks.what: slides down from the top, fading in

tracks.name: middle stripe
tracks.what: slides up from below and turns from dark to white

tracks.name: right stripe
tracks.what: slides down from the top, fast, fading in

tracks.name: words
tracks.what: each word glides into its column after its stripe (left f5-f19, middle f13-f27, right f25-f37)

tracks.name: untilt
tracks.what: the group straightens from the start tilt to 0 and eases from 1.12x to 1x

tracks.name: colour flash
tracks.what: the outer stripes (and the middle word) turn half-way to the flash colour, then snap back

tracks.name: hold
tracks.what: three columns, still (the film grain moves)
